source_policy_review.relevant_terms: Sections 4 and 31 describe platform/trademark and user-generated-content terms. The terms page does not provide a clear open-data grant for copying delivery ratings/review counts into an external database.
source_policy_review.recommendation: Keep these candidate metrics out of the workbook unless reuse permission is established or the workbook owner explicitly accepts platform-attributed, time-stamped delivery-only scores. Never represent them as venue-wide ratings. Do not copy review text or reviewer identifiers.

summary.reason: No open license/clear external reuse grant was found, source snapshots may be stale, and the only observed rating metric is platform-specific delivery feedback rather than a general outlet rating.
